outcomes: Every consumer of the CLI's job model sees one deterministic answer for what traits, side effects, kind and verification outputs a job has
The model stays a pure library: it can be read, tested and depended on without pulling in the engine that drives it
nonGoals: Planning and executing the jobs, which tooling/cli owns
Packaging an extension manifest, which the language extensions own

requirements.text: When two loaded vocabularies declare one verb, the declaration of the extension that sorts first by name applies and the merge warns, naming both extensions.

A job's side effects are the traits its manifest declares, or its verb's default traits when it declares none. The model keeps no side-effect floor: a vocabulary that gives publish no side effect leaves it with none.

A job whose manifest declares no traits takes its verb's default traits whole, kind and workload included. Declared traits replace them wholesale: a command that declares traits without a kind or a workload has none, and one that declares its own keeps it.

A task produces the verification report when it belongs to a verification-kind command and declares a command-output file at the reserved filename, and the criteria projection when it belongs to a criteria-kind command and declares one. No command name decides. A stepless verification job also writes the report.
